content.stem: 在虚拟货币点对点交易中，哪些客户行为是危险信号？(选择两项。)

options.A: 一位客户从一个流行的去中心化混币器那里收到了资金
options.B: 一位顾客用其每月收入中的资金购买虚拟货币
options.C: 一位客户在区块链上进行了一笔交易，而其传统金融机构对此并不知情
options.D: 一位客户从不同来源收到多笔电汇，并使用这些资金购买虚拟货币

risk_flags.note: 已按 中文版3_000301 截图补全 D 选项。

content.stem_en: Which customer actions are red flags for virtual currency peer-to-peer transactions? (Choose two.)

options_en.A: A customer receives funds from a popular decentralized mixer.
options_en.B: A customer uses funds from their monthly income to purchase virtual currency.
options_en.C: A customer makes a transaction on the blockchain that their traditional financial institution is unaware of.
options_en.D: A customer receives multiple wires from different sources and uses those funds to purchase virtual currency.
